# XOR loop analysis:
# edx starts at 0x5b (91)
# For each position i:
#   esi = edx XOR input[i]
#   Compare esi to target[i]
#   edx += input[i]
#
# To reverse: input[i] = target[i] XOR edx, then edx += input[i]

target_bytes = bytes([
    0x1d, 0xed, 0xac, 0x69, 0x0e, 0x9d, 0x38, 0xb0,
    0x5d, 0xf9, 0x68, 0x0b, 0xa5, 0x66, 0xeb, 0x62,
    0x18, 0x96, 0x33, 0xc9, 0x72, 0xb8, 0xf8, 0xcd,
    0x1d, 0x20
])

edx = 0x5b  # Initial value

input_chars = []

    if computed != expected:
        print(f"Mismatch at {i}: computed {hex(computed)}, expected {hex(expected)}")
    edx = (edx + input_chars[i]) & 0xffffffff

minimum_evidence_before_use: a success/flag branch is gated by a literal- or macro-constant condition
